The number of companies whose production of buses is equal to or more than the average demand of buses of all five companies is:
solution:
**Calculation:**

The average of demand of buses of all companies 

⇒ (150 + 145 + 160 + 165 + 155)/5

⇒ 155

According to the question,

The number of companies whose production of buses is equal to or more than the average demand of buses of all five companies

Companies A, C, and D are equal and more than average demand of buses of all five companies.
